mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, identity_key, identity_domain, enabled FROM iam_identity WHERE id = #{identityId}
SELECT id, user_id, identity_key, identity_domain, enabled FROM iam_identity WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_identity (id, user_id, identity_key, identity_domain, enabled) VALUES (#{identityId}, #{userId}, #{identityKey}, #{domain}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE identity_key = VALUES(identity_key), identity_domain = VALUES(identity_domain), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
